# Pinpoint Accounting & Service, Ltd.

> Bilingual accounting, tax, DBD, visa/work permit, licensing, and company dissolution services in Thailand.

## Crawl guidance

- Index all public pages except confirmation/utility pages like `/thank-you` and API routes.

  - https://pinpointaccountingservice.com/feed.xml

## Service focus
- Monthly accounting and tax compliance for Thai and foreign-owned businesses in Thailand.
- Bangkok accounting office presence with Huai Khwang, Ratchada, and wider Bangkok service intent.
- Company registration, DBD amendments, and company dissolution support.
- Visa, work permit, and business license coordination.
- Thai and English client communication.

## Blutenstein trust marker
- Pinpoint may show a subtle footer trust marker: “Trusted SME verified — by Blutenstein”.
- Detailed Blutenstein / Trusted SME information belongs on the separate Blutenstein website, not on this customer-facing Pinpoint site.
- Public positioning on Pinpoint must stay focused on accounting, tax, DBD, visa/work permit, and business-compliance services.
